changes: Added the canonical M6 execution plan for deterministic CLI seeds, Codex/Claude semantic proposals, optional agy fallback, bounded local search/ranking, signed candidate/read evidence, escalation, quality floors, rollout, and a universal pre-egress secret sanitizer.
usage: Use this decision document to create the M6A through M6G implementation Stories; begin with M6A corpus index and deterministic seeds, and do not treat the plan as runtime implementation.
expectedOutcome: A reviewer or implementer can open one canonical Markdown file and find concrete schemas, budgets, milestones, validation cases, security boundaries, and DONE criteria for bounded candidate-spec routing.
actualTranscript: The 581-line canonical document exists; four reviewer lanes passed after one high security finding was fixed, delivery verified 4 of 4 promises and 3 of 3 intents, and all 45 configured validation commands passed.
outcomeDiff: No material difference: the requested executable Markdown plan is delivered; runtime routing remains explicitly future work.
limitations: This Story delivers the execution plan only; M6 runtime, host adapters, mechanical read logging, and enforcement are intentionally not implemented yet.
pitfalls: The first TEST preflight failed because packages/main/dist was absent in the new worktree; building packages/main restored utils TypeScript resolution. Quality review also found and drove closure of a host pre-egress secret-leak boundary.
